create_adaptive_raysampler: create an AdaptiveRaySampler that adaptively samples points on rays based on scene center and extent
create_nearfar_raysampler: create a NearFarRaySampler that samples points between fixed near and far z-planes
build_abstract_mask_raysampler: build an AbstractMaskRaySampler subclass to sample rays from a mask or full image grid
compute_conical_frustum_radii: compute radii of conical frustums in world coordinates from camera and xy grid inputs
sample_rays_from_cameras: sample rendering rays from a batch of cameras using a configured ray sampler forward pass
